rows.name: CI runner images
rows.coverage: `pool.vmImage` in Azure Pipelines is matched against retirement rules; GitLab `image`/`services` and CircleCI images are listed as unclassified references, not judged.

rows.name: Container base images
rows.coverage: `FROM` lines in Dockerfiles and Containerfiles and `services.*.image` in Compose files, for Docker Hub official images with a vendor lifecycle. See [Container base images](detectors/container.md).

rows.name: .NET
rows.coverage: `global.json`, project files, `Directory.Build.props`, `Directory.Packages.props`, and `packages.lock.json`, for .NET release lines past end of support and deprecated NuGet packages. See [.NET](detectors/dotnet.md).

rows.name: Go
rows.coverage: `go` and `toolchain` directives in `go.mod` and `go.work`, and direct `require` entries, for Go release lines past end of support. See [Go](detectors/go.md).

rows.name: Java and Kotlin (JVM)
rows.coverage: JDK declarations in `pom.xml`, Gradle build scripts, `.java-version`, `.sdkmanrc`, and `.tool-versions`, and direct Maven dependencies, for non-LTS JDK releases past end of support and moved artifacts. See [Java and Kotlin](detectors/java.md).

rows.name: Kubernetes APIs
rows.coverage: The literal `apiVersion` and `kind` in YAML manifests, Helm chart templates, and kustomization patches, for API versions the Kubernetes project says are no longer served. See [Kubernetes APIs](detectors/kubernetes.md).

rows.name: GitHub Actions
rows.coverage: Selected first-party Action lifecycle rules and exact workflow locations.

rows.name: Node.js and npm
rows.coverage: Runtime declarations, direct dependencies, lockfiles, and supported source usages.

rows.name: PHP
rows.coverage: Pinned runtime declarations in `.php-version`, `.tool-versions`, `composer.json`, and `composer.lock`, for PHP release lines past end of support and abandoned Composer packages. See [PHP](#php-detector).

rows.name: Python
rows.coverage: Runtime declarations, direct dependencies, common lockfiles, and supported source usages.

rows.name: Ruby
rows.coverage: Pinned runtime declarations in `.ruby-version`, `.tool-versions`, the Gemfile `ruby` directive, and Gemfile.lock `RUBY VERSION`, plus direct gems, for Ruby release lines past end of support and yanked gems. Gem rules can list source usages in Ruby files.

rows.name: Rust
rows.coverage: The pinned toolchain in `rust-toolchain(.toml)` and direct dependencies in `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`, for toolchains older than the newest stable release and unmaintained crates. See [Rust](detectors/rust.md).

rows.name: Swift
rows.coverage: `.swift-version` and `.xcode-version` pins, the `swift-tools-version` line and literal `from:` / `exact:` dependencies in `Package.swift`, and resolved pin versions in `Package.resolved`, for Xcode releases App Store Connect no longer accepts and Swift toolchain lines with a lifecycle rule. The iOS deployment target (`IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET`) of an application target in an `.xcodeproj` `project.pbxproj`, for iOS releases App Store Connect no longer accepts. Libraries and `platforms:` minimums in `Package.swift` are not read for it. See [Swift](#swift-detector).

unsupported.name: Other language and platform ecosystems
unsupported.coverage: Report the limitation; do not infer lifecycle status without a detector.
